title: The NASTE Network
description: A survival server on any version of Minecraft with a PVP hub for practice and tournaments.
body:
**Plugins:**
- EssentialsX
- Gwarp, home set plugin 
- Skript with custom skripts for continuous gameplay
- ThreeByThree, a custom plugin made by n4st3 for the server
- Simple Voice Chat
- Timber
- Mine Spawners
- Variable Ender Chests, doubled ender chests
- Geyser, bedrock support
- ViaVersion & ViaBackwards

**Rules:**
- PvP, raiding, stealing, and griefing player builds are allowed
- No hacked clients, cheats, X-ray, dupes, or exploits unless stated otherwise
- No lag machines or crashing the server
- Spawn killing/trapping is allowed to an extent
- Toxic chat allowed, no slurs, threats, NSFW, spam, DDoS threats/attacks, or sharing personal/internet information
- Alts allowed, no ban evasion or exploit abuse
- Staff interfere only when rules are broken
- If it harms server stability or fairness, it’s not allowed
